description: Certificates logged in certificate transparency for one hostname (or a whole domain with include_subdomains): issuer organisation and DN, not_before and not_after dates, every SAN on the certificate, revocation status and SHA-256 where certspotter has them. Summarises first and last issuance and the issuers used, which shows CA changes and renewal cadence. Default source certspotter (unexpired); include_expired uses crt.sh for the full history.

include_expired.description: Also include names from expired certificates (uses crt.sh). Finds retired hosts; slower.

include_subdomains.description: Also include certificates for names under the host.

source.description: auto = certspotter first (fast, unexpired certificates), crt.sh if it fails or throttles. crtsh = crt.sh only (includes expired with include_expired).

name: get_certificate_history
title: Get certificate history for a host
